items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Mary Kopcza is identified only in the notes as participating in the interview and speaking briefly with the interviewer; she is not mentioned by the interviewee in any personal or professional context.

ctx.x: Jimmy was interviewed in New York City by Monk Rowe on November 16, 1995.
Mary Kopcza also participated in part of the interview.
We are here today in New York filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. My name is Monk Rowe and it’s a great pleasure to have bassist Jimmy Lewis with us. Welcome. You’re a Kansas City native?
